verdict.rationale: Zero is a self-hostable AI email app, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The only API-adjacent surface is MCP.md, a prose capability list with no endpoint schema, and an independent check found no public HTTP API or docs site. The MCP server is an adjacent integration surface, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
